fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. Hover-mechanized platoons are the fastest infantry formation in the CCAF, using hovercraft transports capable of crossing water and open ground at speeds that tracked and wheeled vehicles cannot match. Their speed makes them effective scouts and flanking elements, though the hover transports themselves are fragile. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
